coordinate_system: ALL point/rect/polygon coordinates full-sheet source pixels. source_rect=x,y,width,height. Convert anchors and clip_polygon to crop-local at export.
authorship: Every selected native pose viewed and manually measured. Mixed opposite-phase source sheets; never flipped. Source scale differs and is normalized by body_height, never destructive source resampling.
hand_identity: Near anatomical right arm originates screen-left shoulder. In opposite-phase first poses it crosses chest with fist toward screen-right; far anatomical left hand is behind at screen-left. Leg assignment follows hip-overlap, with uncertainty noted for passing poses.
angle_convention: Tip up0; clockwise positive. Angles provisional for sword overlay review.
measurement_notes: Anatomical scale ruler uses head/torso/straightened limb lengths, not current pose bbox. Opposite sheets generated at larger native scale. Opposite arm ordering and leg overlap differ from initial sheet. Exact phase smoothness and near/far leg tracking in passing poses require independent loop QA; do not claim native gameplay pass. clip_polygon is source selection boundary to exclude neighboring sprites, not a repaint.
